from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import hashlib, json

W, H = 800, 600
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F5F1E8")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Background decorative shapes - soft geometric accents
# Top-left circle accent
draw.ellipse([-80, -80, 220, 220], fill="#E8D5B7")
# Bottom-right circle accent
draw.ellipse([580, 400, 900, 720], fill="#D4C4A8")
# Subtle horizontal band
draw.rectangle([0, 240, W, 380], fill="#EDE6D8")

# Load CJK font
font_path = "/usr/share/fonts/workspacex/NotoSansSC-Common.otf"
try:
    title_font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 96)
    sub_font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 48)
except Exception as e:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot load CJK font: {e}")

# Main title: 开放日
title = "开放日"
bbox_t = draw.textbbox((0, 0), title, font=title_font)
tw = bbox_t[2] - bbox_t[0]
tx = (W - tw) // 2
ty = 180
draw.text((tx, ty), title, fill="#2C2C2C", font=title_font)

# Divider line
line_y = ty + (bbox_t[3] - bbox_t[1]) + 30
draw.line([(W//2 - 120, line_y), (W//2 + 120, line_y)], fill="#8B7355", width=3)

# Subtitle: 欢迎体验
subtitle = "欢迎体验"
bbox_s = draw.textbbox((0, 0), subtitle, font=sub_font)
sw = bbox_s[2] - bbox_s[0]
sx = (W - sw) // 2
sy = line_y + 30
draw.text((sx, sy), subtitle, fill="#5A4A3A", font=sub_font)

# Save
out_path = "/workspace/poster.png"
img.save(out_path, "PNG")

# Verify
with open(out_path, "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()
sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

verify_img = Image.open(out_path)
verify_img.load()  # force full decode
actual_size = verify_img.size

print(json.dumps({
    "path": out_path,
    "size_bytes": len(data),
    "sha256": sha,
    "actual_size": list(actual_size),
    "mode": verify_img.mode
}))
PYEOF

python3 << 'PYEOF'
# Verify text rendering - check for tofu/missing glyphs by sampling pixel regions
from PIL import Image
img = Image.open("/workspace/poster.png")
img.load()

# Check that the title region has non-background pixels (text was rendered)
# Title area roughly y=180..280, center x=200..600
title_region = img.crop((200, 180, 600, 280))
pixels = list(title_region.getdata())
bg_color = (245, 241, 232)  # #F5F1E8
non_bg = sum(1 for p in pixels if abs(p[0]-bg_color[0])>20 or abs(p[1]-bg_color[1])>20 or abs(p[2]-bg_color[2])>20)
total = len(pixels)
print(f"Title region: {non_bg}/{total} non-background pixels ({100*non_bg/total:.1f}%)")

# Subtitle region roughly y=310..370
sub_region = img.crop((250, 310, 550, 370))
pixels_s = list(sub_region.getdata())
non_bg_s = sum(1 for p in pixels_s if abs(p[0]-bg_color[0])>20 or abs(p[1]-bg_color[1])>20 or abs(p[2]-bg_color[2])>20)
total_s = len(pixels_s)
print(f"Subtitle region: {non_bg_s}/{total_s} non-background pixels ({100*non_bg_s/total_s:.1f}%)")

# Check no pure black rectangles (tofu boxes) - sample small blocks
import numpy as np
arr = np.array(img)
# Look for rectangular black outlines that would indicate missing glyphs
# In the text bands, check for clusters of near-black pixels forming boxes
text_band = arr[180:370, 150:650]
dark_mask = (text_band[:,:,0] < 50) & (text_band[:,:,1] < 50) & (text_band[:,:,2] < 50)
dark_count = dark_mask.sum()
print(f"Dark pixels in text band: {dark_count}")
print("Text rendering appears valid" if non_bg > 1000 and non_bg_s > 500 else "WARNING: possible rendering issue")
PYEOF

- **人工目视确认**: 当前环境无 GUI 显示器，无法进行人眼审阅字形美观度、间距微调及色彩感知

# 视觉内容制作

先确定作品用途、受众、实际尺寸、必须准确的文案、已有素材的来源与授权。用简短设计说明记录空间层次、配色、文字与主体关系；用户没有要求时不要额外输出长篇设计宣言。让构图服务真实意图，重要文字不能为了风格被改写。

需要生成式配图时调用 `wx_image_generate`，prompt描述主体、构图、背景、色彩和用途。当前sizeProfile只支持square（1024×1024）。为同一生成意图保留一个idempotencyKey；未知结果后不能换key自动再发。工具会在收费提交之前持久化意图，不能把长时间未返回当成没有提交。

当前供应商不支持编辑。referenceAttachmentIds只可选当前运行真实可见原件；传入参考图会先检查权限，再明确拒绝不支持的编辑，不会悄悄忽略参考图。不要用文字声称已经修改原图。无权素材、未配置服务和未知结果均应明确失败。

文字必须精确、需要其他尺寸或静态PDF时，可复用现有离线Pillow/Matplotlib或PDF技能，用实际安装的字体排版；不要安装运行时依赖或下载字体。先复制原件到 `/workspace`，保留 `/inputs` 不变。离线排版路径与生成式图片是不同选择，不假称供应商支持编辑或任意尺寸。检查方法见 `references/quality.md`。

生成工具返回generated和实际workspacePath、mime、尺寸、sha256、模型与任务信息。这个状态不是用户已获得图片；用 `wx_artifact_publish` 发布同一路径和真实MIME，等待staged之后的正式writeback回执。不要返回供应商短效URL或虚构ready artifactId。失败时不拼凑可点击但不可打开的链接。

最终检查实际文件，确认文字、留白、对齐、主体完整和素材来源。不要只根据文件存在或PNG文件头声称视觉质量合格。对生成式图片里的准确金额、日期、名称或中文文案，应实际查看核对；无法看图时如实记录视觉检查未完成，不推断通过。真实部署限制见 `references/runtime.md`。
